title: Community Shield moved to Cardiff due to The Weeknd concerts at Wembley Stadium
content:
This year’s Community Shield match will be played at Cardiff’s Principality Stadium rather than its traditional venue of Wembley Stadium, due to a scheduling clash with The Weeknd.

The match between the Premier League champions and FA Cup winners is normally played over the weekend before the English top-flight season commences, but an alteration to the 2026-27 calendar means there is a clash at the north London venue with the tour dates of the Canadian singer-songwriter.

The 2026-27 Premier League season will begin over the weekend of August 22-23, but the previous weekend of August 15-16 is already booked at Wembley by The Weeknd, who is playing the venue over five nights.

The 74,000-capacity Principality Stadium, which hosted the match six times between 2001 and 2006 during Wembley’s renovation works, will host the game instead.

The Cardiff ground also hosted the finals of the FA Cup, League Cup and promotion play-offs over that same period, and it was the venue for the 2017 Champions League final.

Crystal Palace won last season’s Community Shield with a penalty-shootout victory over Liverpool.

The 2022 Community Shield was held at Leicester City’s King Power Stadium as Wembley was hosting the final of the Women’s European Championship that weekend.

In 2012, the match was held at Aston Villa’s Villa Park due to Wembley’s commitments to the Olympic football tournament.
